name: Mahou Shoujo Nayuta
source:
At another world. A mysterious disease has been rampant for several years. Some of the sufferers transform themselves into monsters, and attack humans. But one day, there appears a girl, who suffers this mysterious disease but hunts the monsters...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081201184749/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1006199]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
另一个世界里，一种神秘疾病已肆虐数年。部分患者会变成怪物，袭击人类。然而某天，一名同样身患疾病、却专门猎杀怪物的少女那由多出现了……

[译自 [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081201184749/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1006199]Eroge Shop[/url]]
